title: Handley Page Halifax EB203
memorial_details:
Rectangular, brass plaque mounted on a wooden backboard. Dedication is inscribed in black, upper and lower-case letters.

This plaque is erected to the memory of the crew
inscription: This plaque is erected to the memory of the crew of Halifax Mk.V EB203 from 1664 HCU / (RCAF) Dishforth which crashed near this site at 23.25 hours on the night of Saturday 15th April / 1944. / (7 Names) / "Remembered with Honour"
